review.StaticFieldLeak: The retained session-owned static controller now holds three additional presentation references. PreviewPlaybackMenus.close() nulls all three; its regression asserts this. Existing PlayerActivity.stop() invokes PlayerController.stop(), which closes the window. No warning suppression or new global lifetime is introduced. Physical lifecycle/soak acceptance remains pending.
review.ViewConstructor: PlaybackSubtitlePanel is created programmatically with its Activity/backend/navigation adapter, never inflated from XML. No unused XML constructor was added.
review.RtlHardcoded: Explicit RIGHT gravity restores the retained legacy Audio/Video/More shell exactly, as required. Locale-dependent repositioning is outside this presentation scope.
